verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes free startup explainers on its own site. These include insight briefings on early-stage financing instruments (CLAs, SAFEs, ASAs) and on equity (ESOPs, Section 19a, VSOP alternatives), plus a free GmbH foundation starter kit and questionnaire covering formation, and a Venture Deals in Germany guide page. missing for 10: evidence of an organized knowledge-base or FAQ hub rather than scattered insight articles, confirmation that the content is plain-language and founder-oriented, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: This briefing explains how seedstrapping affects convertible loan agreements (CLAs), SAFEs and advance subscription agreements (ASAs), where governance and valuation cap risks arise, and when a priced equity round is the better structure.
Section 19a GITA enables start-ups to offer their employees equity participations either free of charge or at a discount
